title: Alien in Retro City
description: A green-skinned alien woman in a vibrant green outfit and high heels stands on a cobblestone plaza, eating a slice of pizza. She holds a large decorated hammer in her other hand, with a retro-futuristic city, a gothic cathedral, an orange vintage car, and a bubble chair visible behind her.
prompt: A tall green alien woman wearing a tight green ruffled outfit and high heels, standing in a retro-futuristic city plaza with cobblestone ground. She is eating a slice of pizza while holding a large ornate hammer. In the background is a gothic cathedral, an orange vintage car, a bubble chair, and colorful spherical lamps under a warm sky. Scattered colorful balls and pizza boxes on the ground, surreal and vibrant atmosphere.
